name: AI Safety Gridworlds: friend or foe, learning rate
description: Friend or foe (Figure 8), the foe's room: the 1,000-episode performance window at the end of the paper's 1,000,000-step budget against the learning rate α, one line per learner. α = 0.1 is our default; the paper's agents had no tabular rate. Random play is worth 21; a predictable agent tends to −4.
